hook.convey: a fixed number of things set out in equal rows with none left over → each working arrangement is a rectangle → its rows and its row length are factors of the number

use.hi: School ke garden mein kuch paudhe lagane hain, barabar rows mein, aur koi plant bachna nahi chahiye. Kitni rows ban sakti hain, yahi aaj dhoondhenge.
use.en: Some saplings must be planted in the school garden, in equal rows, and no plant may be left over. How many rows can we make? That is what we find today.

use.hi: Cricket camp ke bachchon ki photo leni hai. Sabko barabar rows mein khada karna hai, koi bachcha bahar na rahe. Kaun-kaun si rows chalengi, yeh dekhenge.
use.en: We need a photo of the children at a cricket camp. Everyone must stand in equal rows, with no child left out. We will see which rows work.

explain.convey: 12 chairs as 3 rows of 4 → a full rectangle, none left over → 3 × 4 = 12 → 3 and 4 are factors of 12; transfer: same 12 chairs in 2 rows

point.hi: Yeh 12 kursiyan hain: 3 rows, aur har row mein 4, yaani 4 columns. Koi kursi nahi bachi, aur 3 × 4 = 12. Isliye 3 aur 4 dono 12 ke factors hain.
point.en: These are 12 chairs: 3 rows with 4 in each row, that is 4 columns. No chair is left over, and 3 × 4 = 12. So 3 and 4 are both factors of 12.

prompt.hi: Inhi 12 kursiyon ko 2 barabar rows mein lagayein, toh har row mein kitni kursiyan hongi?
prompt.en: If we set these same 12 chairs in 2 equal rows, how many chairs will be in each row?

explain.convey: 6 chairs in one long row → still equal rows, nothing left over → the 1-row arrangement counts → 1 and the number itself are factors; transfer: list all factors of 6 from the rows that work

point.hi: Yeh 6 kursiyan ek hi lambi row mein hain, yaani 6 columns. Ek row, har row mein 6, aur koi kursi nahi bachi. Yeh bhi barabar rows ka poora sahi tareeka hai.
point.en: These 6 chairs are in one long row, that is 6 columns. One row, 6 in the row, and no chair is left over. This is also a fully correct way of making equal rows.

prompt.hi: Yeh 6 kursiyan 2 barabar rows mein bhi lagti hain, aur 3 barabar rows mein bhi. 4 ya 5 rows mein kursi bachti hai. Toh 6 ke saare factors kaun-kaun se hain?
prompt.en: These 6 chairs also fit in 2 equal rows, and in 3 equal rows. With 4 or 5 rows a chair is left over. So what are all the factors of 6?

explain.convey: 12 chairs make three rectangles (1 × 12, 2 × 6, 3 × 4); 13 chairs only one long row (1 × 13) → the bigger number has fewer factors → size does not decide; transfer: 14 vs 19

point.hi: 12 kursiyan teen rectangle banati hain: 1 × 12, 2 × 6 aur 3 × 4. 13 kursiyan sirf ek: 1 × 13, ek lambi row. 13 bada number hai, phir bhi 13 ke factors kam hain.
point.en: 12 chairs make three rectangles: 1 × 12, 2 × 6 and 3 × 4. 13 chairs make only one: 1 × 13, one long row. 13 is the bigger number, yet 13 has fewer factors.

prompt.hi: Aise hi rectangle banakar socho. Kiske factors zyada hain, 14 ya 19?
prompt.en: Think by making rectangles like these. Which has more factors, 14 or 19?

problem.hi: Ramesh ke paas 16 paudhe hain. Unhe garden mein barabar rows mein lagana hai, koi paudha na bache. Har rectangle se 16 ke factors milenge. 16 ke saare factors kya hain?
problem.en: Ramesh has 16 saplings. He must plant them in the garden in equal rows, with none left over. Each rectangle gives factors of 16. What are all the factors of 16?

givens.hi: barabar rows, koi paudha na bache

steps.result: 1 × 16, 2 × 8 aur 4 × 4, teeno mein koi paudha nahi bachta

why.hi: 16 ko 1, 2 aur 4 se poora baanta ja sakta hai
why.en: 16 can be shared exactly by 1, 2 and 4

steps.result: har baar kuch paudhe bach jaate hain, aur 8 rows wala 2 × 8 ulta hai

why.hi: 16 in mein se kisi se poora nahi bantta, aur 8 rows mein 2-2 wala rectangle pehle mil chuka hai
why.en: 16 is not shared exactly by any of these, and the 8 rows of 2 rectangle was already found

prompt.hi: Rectangle mile: 1 × 16, 2 × 8 aur 4 × 4. Har rectangle ke dono number factor hain. Toh 16 ke saare factors kya hain?
prompt.en: The rectangles are 1 × 16, 2 × 8 and 4 × 4. Both numbers of each rectangle are factors. So what are all the factors of 16?

why.hi: har rectangle mein koi paudha nahi bacha, isliye uske dono number 16 ko poora baantte hain
why.en: no sapling was left over in any rectangle, so both its numbers divide 16 exactly

prompt.hi: Ek lambi row bhi barabar rows mein ginte hain. {friend} ka kehna hai ki 11 kursiyon ko barabar rows mein lagane ka koi tareeka nahi hai. Kya yeh sahi hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: One long row also counts as equal rows. {friend} says there is no way to set 11 chairs in equal rows. Is that right, yes or no?

accept: nahi, ek lambi row mein lag sakti hain

prompt.hi: Ek hall mein 20 kursiyan hain, doosre mein 23. Kis hall ki kursiyan zyada tarah ke rectangle mein lag sakti hain, 20 wali ya 23 wali?
prompt.en: One hall has 20 chairs, another has 23. Which hall's chairs can be set out as more kinds of rectangle, the 20 or the 23?

prompt.hi: 27 kursiyan barabar rows mein lagani hain, koi kursi na bache. Kitni rows ho sakti hain, saare tareeke batao.
prompt.en: 27 chairs must go in equal rows, with no chair left over. How many rows can there be? Give every way.

ladder.why: 12 chairs in 3 rows, the e1 case → one arrangement, find the row length
20 shuttlecocks, choose the row count that works from 3, 4, 6 → test each by sharing
15 dots as every rectangle → read the factor pairs off the arrays, including the long row
54 lights, more than one row count works among 6, 8, 9 → test each, keep all that fit
36 students, every arrangement as rows × students → full set of rectangles for a bigger number

remediation.move: 9 chairs in one long row → every chair used, rows equal (just one) → allowed → 1 × 9, so 1 and 9 are factors; then a number whose only rectangle is the long row

say.hi: Yeh 9 kursiyan ek lambi row mein hain, yaani 9 columns, aur saari kursiyan lag gayin. Yeh bhi barabar rows hain, isliye 1 aur khud number hamesha factor hote hain.
say.en: These 9 chairs are in one long row, that is 9 columns, and every chair is used. This is equal rows too, so 1 and the number itself are always factors.

prompt.hi: 35 kursiyan barabar rows mein lagani hain, koi na bache. Toh 35 ke saare factors kaun-kaun se hain?
prompt.en: 35 chairs must go in equal rows, none left over. So what are all the factors of 35?

remediation.move: 12 counters make 1 × 12, 2 × 6, 3 × 4; 13 counters make only the single line 1 × 13 → count the shapes that worked, not the size of the number

say.hi: 12 kursiyan 1 × 12, 2 × 6 aur 3 × 4 teen rectangle banati hain, par 13 kursiyan sirf 1 × 13. Number bada hone se factors zyada nahi ho jaate.
say.en: 12 chairs made three rectangles, 1 × 12, 2 × 6 and 3 × 4, but 13 chairs only 1 × 13. A bigger number does not mean more factors.

prompt.hi: Kursiyan lekar rectangle banakar socho. Kiske factors zyada hain, 9 ya 11?
prompt.en: Think by making rectangles of chairs. Which has more factors, 9 or 11?

remediation.move: 3 rows of 9 chairs → one rectangle gives two factors at once, the rows and the row length → after finding a row count, write its partner

say.hi: Yeh rectangle 3 rows aur 9 columns ka hai. Har rectangle do factor deta hai, isliye 3 ke saath 9 bhi 27 ka factor hai.
say.en: This rectangle has 3 rows and 9 columns. Every rectangle gives two factors, so along with 3, 9 is also a factor of 27.

prompt.hi: 32 kursiyan 4 barabar rows mein lagi hain. Isi rectangle se 4 ke alawa 32 ka kaunsa factor milta hai?
prompt.en: 32 chairs are set in 4 equal rows. Besides 4, which factor of 32 does this rectangle give?

bridgeToNext.hi: Rectangle banakar factors mile. Ab ek tez tareeka dekhenge: factors ko jodiyon mein dhoondhna, taaki koi factor chhoote nahi.
bridgeToNext.en: We found factors by making rectangles. Next we see a quicker way: finding factors in pairs, so that no factor is missed.

hook.convey: a group must be split into equal teams in every possible way → trying sizes at random misses some → test in order, write each pair, stop when pairs repeat

use.hi: Cricket coach ko camp ke bachchon ko barabar teams mein baantna hai, aur har tareeka pata karna hai. Koi tareeka chhoot na jaaye, iske liye hum jodiyan banayenge.
use.en: A cricket coach must split the camp's children into equal teams and know every way to do it. So that no way is missed, we will make pairs.

use.hi: Ek game mein coins ko barabar bags mein bharna hai, aur saare tareeke dhoondhne hain. Kram se jodiyan banao, toh koi tareeka nahi chhootega.
use.en: In a game, coins must be packed into equal bags, and we must find every way. Make pairs in order, and no way will be missed.

explain.convey: factors of 20 come in pairs whose product is 20: 1 × 20, 2 × 10, 4 × 5; 3 does not divide 20 → every pair gives two factors; transfer: count the factors from the pairs

point.hi: 20 ki jodiyan dekho: 1 × 20, 2 × 10 aur 4 × 5. Har jodi ka guna 20 hai. 3 nahi chalta, kyunki 20 ko 3 se baanto toh kuch bachta hai.
point.en: Look at the pairs of 20: 1 × 20, 2 × 10 and 4 × 5. Each pair multiplies to 20. 3 does not work, because sharing 20 by 3 leaves something over.

prompt.hi: In jodiyon ke saare number gino. 20 ke kitne factors hain?
prompt.en: Count all the numbers in these pairs. How many factors does 20 have?

explain.convey: test 1, 2, 3, ... in order for 30: 1 × 30, 2 × 15, 3 × 10, 4 fails, 5 × 6; next would be 6 × 5, already found → stop; transfer: count the factors of 40 the same way

point.hi: 30 ki jodiyan 1 se kram se banao: 1 × 30, 2 × 15, 3 × 10. 4 se 30 poora nahi bantta. Phir 5 × 6. Agli jodi 6 × 5 hogi, jo dobara aa rahi hai, isliye yahin ruk jao.
point.en: Make the pairs of 30 in order from 1: 1 × 30, 2 × 15, 3 × 10. 4 does not divide 30 exactly. Then 5 × 6. The next pair would be 6 × 5, which comes again, so stop here.

prompt.hi: Isi tarah 1 se kram se 40 ki jodiyan banao. 40 ke kitne factors hain?
prompt.en: In the same way, make the pairs for 40 in order from 1. How many factors does 40 have?

problem.hi: 28 ke saare factors dhoondho, jodiyan bana kar, taaki koi chhoote nahi.
problem.en: Find all the factors of 28 by making pairs, so that none is missed.

do.hi: 1 se shuru karke kram se jodiyan banao
do.en: Start at 1 and make pairs in order

why.hi: har jodi ka guna 28 hona chahiye, aur 28 ko 3 se baanto toh 1 bachta hai
why.en: each pair must multiply to 28, and sharing 28 by 3 leaves 1 over

steps.result: 5 aur 6 nahi chalte, aur 7 × 4 pehle mil chuka, toh ruk jao

why.hi: ab jodiyan ulti hokar dobara aa rahi hain
why.en: the pairs are now coming again, turned round

prompt.hi: Jodiyan mili: 1 × 28, 2 × 14 aur 4 × 7. Toh 28 ke saare factors chhote se bade kram mein kya hain?
prompt.en: The pairs are 1 × 28, 2 × 14 and 4 × 7. So what are all the factors of 28, from smallest to biggest?

why.hi: har jodi ke dono number factor hain, aur 4 × 7 ke baad jodiyan dobara aane lagti hain
why.en: both numbers of every pair are factors, and after 4 × 7 the pairs start coming again

prompt.hi: {friend} ne 45 ke factors likhe: 1, 3, 9, 15, 45. Ek factor chhoot gaya. Woh kaunsa hai?
prompt.en: {friend} wrote the factors of 45 as 1, 3, 9, 15, 45. One factor is missing. Which one is it?

prompt.hi: {friend} ka kehna hai ki 14 ke factors sirf 2 aur 7 hain. Kaunse do factors chhoot gaye?
prompt.en: {friend} says the only factors of 14 are 2 and 7. Which two factors were missed?

prompt.hi: Kram se jodiyan banakar 50 ke saare factors batao.
prompt.en: Make pairs in order and give all the factors of 50.

ladder.why: factors of 10, two pairs only → the pairing routine on a small number, 1 and 10 included
factors of 18, three pairs → test in order, stop at the repeat
factors of 21 inside a sticker story → odd number, 2 fails, pairs 1 × 21 and 3 × 7
error spot: a list of 30's factors without 1 and 30 → the always-there pair named
24 chairs, every possible row count → all four pairs read out of a story

remediation.move: factor rainbow for 24: arcs join 1-24, 2-12, 3-8, 4-6 → each factor found brings its partner → a number with no arc is not yet checked

say.hi: Har factor ka ek saathi hota hai, jiske saath guna karke number banta hai. 24 mein 3 mila, toh uska saathi 8 bhi likho, 24 ki jodiyan hain 1 × 24, 2 × 12, 3 × 8, 4 × 6.
say.en: Every factor has a partner that multiplies with it to make the number. In 24 we found 3, so write its partner 8 too, as in 1 × 24, 2 × 12, 3 × 8, 4 × 6.

prompt.hi: {friend} ne 36 ke factors likhe: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12, 18, 36. Kaunsa factor chhoot gaya?
prompt.en: {friend} wrote the factors of 36: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12, 18, 36. Which factor is missing?

remediation.move: 1 × 15 is a full pair, like one long row of 15 → both 1 and 15 divide 15 exactly → every number's list starts with 1 and ends with itself

say.hi: 1 × 15 bhi ek poori jodi hai, bilkul ek lambi row jaisi. Isliye 15 ki jodiyan 1 × 15 aur 3 × 5 hain, aur 1 aur 15 bhi uske factors hain.
say.en: 1 × 15 is also a full pair, just like one long row. So the pairs of 15 are 1 × 15 and 3 × 5, and 1 and 15 are factors of it too.

prompt.hi: {friend} ne 22 ke factors likhe: 2 aur 11. Kaunse do factors aur aayenge?
prompt.en: {friend} wrote the factors of 22 as 2 and 11. Which two more factors belong?

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab hum kisi bhi number ke saare factors dhoondh sakte hain. Aage dekhenge ki factor aur multiple mein kya fark hai, aur kaise pata karein ki ek number doosre ko poora baantta hai ya nahi.
bridgeToNext.en: Now we can find all the factors of any number. Next we see how a factor differs from a multiple, and how to tell whether one number divides another exactly.

hook.convey: packing a fixed number of sweets into boxes of one size with none left over → the box size is a factor of the total, the total is a multiple of the box size → two names for one fact

use.hi: Kitchen mein 30 laddoo bane hain, aur unhe 5-5 ke dabbon mein bharna hai, koi laddoo na bache. Aaj dekhenge ki 5 aur 30 ka aapas mein kya rishta hai.
use.en: 30 laddoos have been made in the kitchen, and they go into boxes of 5, with none left over. Today we see how 5 and 30 are related.

use.hi: Ek bus mein 36 seats hain, aur har row mein 4 seats. 36 aur 4 ka rishta do naam se bola jaata hai, aaj dono naam seekhenge.
use.en: A bus has 36 seats, with 4 seats in each row. The link between 36 and 4 has two names, and today we learn both.

explain.convey: jumps of 7 from 0 land on 7, 14 → 14 reached exactly in 2 jumps → 7 is a factor of 14, 14 is a multiple of 7 → factor = jump size, multiple = landing spot; transfer: do jumps of 7 reach 30

point.hi: Yeh 7-7 ki chhalaang 0 se shuru hoti hai, aur 7 aur 14 par girti hai. Do chhalaang mein theek 14 aaya, kuch nahi bacha. Toh 7, 14 ka factor hai, aur 14, 7 ka multiple hai.
point.en: These jumps of 7 start at 0 and land on 7 and 14. In two jumps we reach exactly 14, with nothing left. So 7 is a factor of 14, and 14 is a multiple of 7.

prompt.hi: Isi 7-7 ki chhalaang ko aage badhao. Kya 7, 30 ka factor hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: Carry these jumps of 7 further. Is 7 a factor of 30, yes or no?

explain.convey: factors of 12 divide 12 exactly → none bigger than 12; multiples of 12 are in its table (12, 24, 36, 48) → none smaller than 12 → bigger-than-the-number means multiple, not factor; transfer: pick the factors of 15 from a mixed set

point.hi: 12 ke factors 12 ko poora baantte hain, isliye koi bhi factor 12 se bade nahi hote. 12 ke multiples 12 ki table mein aate hain: 12, 24, 36, 48.
point.en: The factors of 12 divide 12 exactly, so no factor is bigger than 12. The multiples of 12 come in the table of 12: 12, 24, 36, 48.

prompt.hi: Ab 15 ke liye socho. 30, 5, 45 aur 3 mein se 15 ke factors kaun se hain?
prompt.en: Now think about 15. Out of 30, 5, 45 and 3, which are factors of 15?

explain.convey: in the table of 8 one jump goes from 24 straight to 32 → 28 falls between → 28 ÷ 8 leaves 4 → 8 is not a factor of 28 and 28 is not a multiple of 8; transfer: the biggest multiple of 8 under 50

point.hi: 8 ki table mein 24 ke baad 8 ki ek chhalaang seedha 32 par girti hai. 28 beech mein reh jaata hai, aur 28 ko 8 se baanto toh 4 bachta hai. Isliye 8, 28 ka factor nahi hai.
point.en: In the table of 8, one jump of 8 after 24 lands straight on 32. 28 is left in between, and sharing 28 by 8 leaves 4 over. So 8 is not a factor of 28.

prompt.hi: Inhi 8-8 ki chhalaangon ko aage badhao. 50 se chhota, 8 ka sabse bada multiple kaunsa hai?
prompt.en: Carry these jumps of 8 further. What is the biggest multiple of 8 that is smaller than 50?

problem.hi: Do sawaal hain. Kya 6, 45 ka factor hai? Aur kya 45, 9 ka multiple hai?
problem.en: There are two questions. Is 6 a factor of 45? And is 45 a multiple of 9?

find.hi: 6 se 45 poora bantta hai ya nahi, aur 9 se 45 poora bantta hai ya nahi
find.en: whether 6 divides 45 exactly, and whether 9 divides 45 exactly

do.hi: 6 ki table mein 45 ke paas dekho
do.en: Look near 45 in the table of 6

steps.result: 6 × 7 = 42 aur 6 × 8 = 48, toh 45 beech mein hai aur 3 bachte hain

why.hi: 6 se 45 poora nahi bantta, isliye 6, 45 ka factor nahi hai
why.en: 45 is not shared exactly by 6, so 6 is not a factor of 45

do.hi: Ab 9 ki table ko 45 ki taraf badhao
do.en: Now take the table of 9 up towards 45

why.hi: 45 tabhi 9 ka multiple hai jab 9 ki chhalaangein theek 45 par giren
why.en: 45 is a multiple of 9 only if jumps of 9 land exactly on 45

prompt.hi: 9 × 4 = 36 tak aa gaye. 0 se theek 45 tak pahunchne mein 9 ki kitni chhalaang lagengi?
prompt.en: We have reached 9 × 4 = 36. How many jumps of 9 from 0 does it take to reach exactly 45?

answer.hi: 6, 45 ka factor nahi hai, aur 9 × 5 = 45, isliye 45, 9 ka multiple hai
answer.en: 6 is not a factor of 45, and 9 × 5 = 45, so 45 is a multiple of 9

why.hi: 6 ki table 45 ko chhod deti hai aur 3 bachte hain, par 9 ki chhalaangein theek 45 par girti hain
why.en: the table of 6 skips 45 and leaves 3 over, but jumps of 9 land exactly on 45

prompt.hi: Inmein se kaunsa 18 ka factor hai: 36, 6 ya 54?
prompt.en: Which of these is a factor of 18: 36, 6 or 54?

prompt.hi: {friend} ka kehna hai ki 40, 8 ka factor hai, kyunki 8 × 5 = 40. Sahi kya hai: 40, 8 ka factor hai ya multiple?
prompt.en: {friend} says 40 is a factor of 8, because 8 × 5 = 40. What is right: is 40 a factor or a multiple of 8?

prompt.hi: {friend} ka kehna hai ki 6, 3 ka multiple hai, aur 3, 6 ka factor hai. Kya dono baatein sahi hain, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: {friend} says 6 is a multiple of 3, and 3 is a factor of 6. Are both statements right, yes or no?

ladder.why: is 7 a factor of 42 → one divisibility test by the table of 7
say the factor and the multiple sentence for 5 and 20 → the two names for one fact
84 wristbands in packets of 8 → a no, with the left-over amount as the reason
48 laddoos, box sizes between 5 and 10 → test several divisors, keep those that fit

remediation.move: jumps of 4 from 0 → land on 4, 8, 12 → 12 reached exactly in 3 jumps → jump size 4 = factor of 12, landing spot 12 = multiple of 4; a factor is never bigger than the number

say.hi: 4-4 ki chhalaang 0 se 4, 8 aur 12 par girti hai, aur teen chhalaang mein theek 12 aata hai. Chhalaang ka size 4 factor hai, aur girne ki jagah 12 multiple hai.
say.en: Jumps of 4 from 0 land on 4, 8 and 12, and three jumps reach exactly 12. The jump size 4 is the factor, and the landing spot 12 is the multiple.

prompt.hi: Inmein se kaunsa 20 ka factor hai: 40, 5 ya 60?
prompt.en: Which of these is a factor of 20: 40, 5 or 60?
